contract_id_format: derived from owner_id when an exception is persisted

autonomous_owner_v1.authority_scope: saved role, office, command, custody and legal authority only
autonomous_owner_v1.knowledge_rule: act only on saved or validly delivered information
autonomous_owner_v1.material_trigger_rule: Combat, movement, casualty, shortage, leadership change, discovery, delivery, contract change, political decision or threshold crossing creates an exact event or information-path record.
autonomous_owner_v1.replanning_policy: At its aggregate review boundary or any earlier causal wake-up, reassess goals, authority, knowledge, health, resources, dependencies, opposition and risks. Complete, block, fail, continue or supersede the current plan and create a lawful successor plan when autonomy permits.
autonomous_owner_v1.result_requirement: Every crossed interval resolves as progress, maintenance, recovery, decline, loss, transformation, closure, blockage, or explicit no material change with a causal reason.
autonomous_owner_v1.safe_compaction_policy: Stable distant routine may share an aggregate boundary review. Split immediately on material events, owner-local domain deadlines, thresholds, player dependencies or causal intersections.

featured_original_v1.authority_scope: saved role, office, command, custody and legal authority only
featured_original_v1.knowledge_rule: act only on saved or validly delivered information
featured_original_v1.material_trigger_rule: Combat, movement, casualty, promotion, retirement, relationship change, discovery or threshold crossing creates an exact event.
featured_original_v1.replanning_policy: Reassess concrete goals, assignment, location, relationships, health, resources, knowledge, opposition and age stage; never repeat a numbered placeholder plan.
featured_original_v1.result_requirement: Every interval has a causal semantic result.
featured_original_v1.safe_compaction_policy: Only compact equivalent routine intervals without a threshold or material event.

named_life_course_v1.authority_scope: automatic age updates and autonomous NPC life-course only; no player life choices
named_life_course_v1.knowledge_rule: offscreen events remain hidden until a valid information path
named_life_course_v1.material_trigger_rule: Birthday, promotion, deployment, injury, retirement or death creates an exact transaction.
named_life_course_v1.replanning_policy: Each NPC receives concrete age-stage and circumstance-based review. Wei receives age updates only.
named_life_course_v1.result_requirement: Every monthly review records exact birthday and life-course changes.
named_life_course_v1.safe_compaction_policy: Monthly boundaries may be compacted only after birthdays and material events are processed in order.

team_doctrine_training_v1.authority_scope: only approved team doctrine and training schedules; never creates a team or member commitment
team_doctrine_training_v1.knowledge_rule: uses saved roster, authority, location, health, instructors, facilities and equipment
team_doctrine_training_v1.material_trigger_rule: Doctrine approval, roster change, injury, facility loss, evaluation or deconfliction failure creates an exact event.
team_doctrine_training_v1.replanning_policy: Training plans change only through approved doctrine revisions or causal blockers.
team_doctrine_training_v1.result_requirement: Verified attendance produces exact member credits, cohesion and deconfliction evidence; missing evidence produces blockage.
team_doctrine_training_v1.safe_compaction_policy: Weekly cycles may compact only when membership, schedule, attendance inputs and blockers are unchanged.

stable_seed_rule: sha256(world_seed + owner_id) first 64 bits; do not store repetitive per-owner seeds
goal_rule: Use the owner’s saved goal/current_plan/assignment/standing orders. Do not duplicate generic goals in the contract registry.
autonomous_action_rule: Autonomous reviews and causal wake-ups may select lawful missions, movement, conflict, diplomacy, trade, recovery, recruitment or other material actions from current owner state. Material actions must be instantiated before outcome resolution.
